description:
****This is NOT a solicitation.  This is a request for information only and it is requested that all interested vendors submit capability statements in response to this notice.***  Please email capability statements to: jennifer.k.stevens7.civ@us.navy.mil. 

***Note: This opportunity will be restricted to SeaPort NxG Mac Holders only***

1.  General:  This is a non-personal services contract to provide Program Analysis, Administrative Support Services, and Logistic Support to Commander, Naval Surface Force, U.S. Pacific Fleet (COMNAVSURFPAC) Inspector General. The Government shall not exercise any supervision or control over the contract service providers performing the services herein.  Such contract service providers shall be accountable solely to the Contractor who, in turn is responsible to the Government.

1.1  Description of Services/Introduction:  The contractor shall provide all personnel necessary to perform Program Analysis, Administrative Support Services, and Logistic Support to COMNAVSURFPAC Inspector General as defined in this Performance Work Statement except for those items specified as government furnished property and services.  The contractor shall perform to the standards in this contract.

Services are currently being performed under contract/task order: N0017819D8379/N0024425F3020 by Quantum Dynamics, Inc.

Period of Performance:  The period of performance shall be for one Base year and one Option year of 12 months each. The Period of Performance reads as follows:

Base Year:  9 June 2026 – 8 June 2027

Option Year 1:  9 June 2027 – 8 June 2028

**For more detailed information, please reference attached PWS.**
